title: Estimating measurement benefit and referral uncertainty in dementia assessment
status: Locally specified extension before its performance evaluation; previous study results are known; not a public preregistration
existing_data_rule: Keep original patient partitions. Extension development uses original development patients only. Any original holdout reuse is explicitly exploratory.
new_data_rule: OpenNeuro ds004504 measured preprocessed EEG; AD versus FTD only; healthy controls excluded to study symptomatic differential diagnosis and avoid the documented MMSE ceiling in controls. New stratified 30 percent holdout before fitting.
eeg_features: First 120 seconds of provider-denoised recording; Welch 2-second Hann windows with 50 percent overlap; log relative delta 0.5-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-13, beta 13-30 Hz power normalized over 0.5-30 Hz; mean across channels in five prespecified scalp regions; one 20-feature row per participant. Basic age, recorded sex, MMSE.
classification: Logistic C=1 or additive quadratic splines with 3 quantile knots per continuous input and logistic C=0.5; binary input linear; training-only median imputation and scaling; sigmoid calibration unless ablated
gates: Ridge alpha=10 for Brier and confidence targets; BayesianRidge on standardized basic inputs with explicit constant and fit_intercept=False. Posterior mean uncertainty excludes observation noise and upstream classifier/cross-fit uncertainty.
information_baseline: Training-only ridge conditional mean for standardized advanced inputs, Ledoit-Wolf residual covariance, 32 Gaussian Monte Carlo draws; entropy of average advanced probability minus average entropy. Simplified model-based information baseline, not an EDDI or GSMRL reproduction; draws are hypothetical integrations, not real training patients.
primary_extension_comparison: Bayesian mean minus one posterior mean standard deviation versus Bayesian mean alone, logistic at 30 percent capacity; OASIS2 original test reuse exploratory, new EEG holdout separate feasibility check
learning_rule: Same development outer folds; stratified subset of training participants; logistic only; no new holdout tuning
stability_rule: Fit full pipeline on independent 80 percent stratified subsamples without replacement of a development-only training set; fixed development-only validation group; measure pairwise referral Jaccard and inclusion frequencies
stress_rule: Development outer evaluation inputs only; one fixed perturbation realization per fold and level; source features unchanged; perturb continuous basic inputs using training standard deviations or set to missing; measured advanced features unchanged; descriptive simulation
cost_rule: Hypothetical FP-error units; threshold 1/(1+w); separate ridge gate learns cross-fitted reduction in weighted classification loss; acquire only when predicted reduction exceeds cost. Report all/no acquisition and exact 30 percent uncertainty and benefit policies; no monetary or clinical validity claim.
inference: Class-stratified paired bootstrap at fixed fitted model and realized allocation; no refitting or reranking. Development repeats correlated and descriptive. All secondary comparisons exploratory with no multiplicity-adjusted superiority claim.
theory: Conditional expected-gain ranking at equal costs
Top-k regret at most 2k epsilon under uniform gain estimation error
Brier value of information equals conditional variance for coherent Bayes probabilities
Posterior lower score is a heuristic, not distribution-free risk control
restrictions: No synthetic patient or outcome fabrication
No same-participant EEG epochs split across folds
No cross-modal deployment or external validation claim for separately refitted EEG models
